nodes.text: Welcome to the Veiled Moon. Looking for candles, herbs, or something sharper?

choices.label: I need supplies for protection work.

nodes.text: Rosemary and salt for thresholds. Black candles if you mean business. Don't skip the intent.
Cunning folk worked with what was at hand — pins, pins, petitions, and nerve. Read the primer if you're serious.
Morning! Bread's fresh. Tea helps when you've been up all night with... whatever you witches get up to.
Herbal teas and salts only. If you need something stronger, speak to Mara.
The archive holds county folklore records. Some entries mention wards older than the town itself.
Bay for divination, rosemary for protection, sage for cleansing. Write them down — memory fails under stress.
Coffee, tea, and a quiet corner. The study circle meets nearby — don't stir trouble in my café.
We gather to compare notes — never to play at Hollywood magic. Are you practicing seriously?
Good. Raise your ritual skill through repetition. Consistency beats flash every time.
